location_lifecycle.label: Facility Lifecycle
location_lifecycle.help: Operational lifecycle of a plant, work center, warehouse, or QC lab. Occupancy, booking availability, and record activation are separate.

planned.help: The plant, work center, warehouse, or QC lab is being prepared and has not started operating.

operational.help: The plant, work center, warehouse, or QC lab is operating. This does not indicate vacant space or booking availability.

under_maintenance.help: The plant, work center, warehouse, or QC lab is undergoing maintenance; operating restrictions are managed separately.

temporarily_closed.help: Operations at the plant, work center, warehouse, or QC lab are paused with an intention to reopen.

closed.help: Operations have ended at the plant, work center, warehouse, or QC lab.
